stories.label: Iran crisis — war preparations intensify as nuclear ultimatum deadline nears
stories.summary: Deadline ~Feb 23-24. Iran running dual-track: diplomatic envoys scrambling for deal while military prepares for all-out war. University protests creating domestic pressure. Trump open to 'token' enrichment. Pentagon has strike plans but UK blocked base use. Most critical moment in the crisis.

stories.label: US tariff upheaval — capital flight accelerates after 15% hike
stories.summary: Capital flight from US markets accelerating. SCOTUS struck down IEEPA tariffs 6-3. Trump at 15% via Section 122. Constitutional confrontation deepening. Not selected this cycle — no major new development beyond what was covered.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia conflict — Lviv terror attack expands war's reach
stories.summary: Terror attack in Lviv (western Ukraine) killed policewoman and wounded 15 — investigated as terrorism, not missile strike. New dimension: internal sabotage reaching areas far from front lines. Diplomatic talks remain stalled.

stories.label: Memory chip competition — Samsung reclaims DRAM lead amid Chinese challenge
stories.summary: Samsung regained global DRAM market leadership in Q4. Comes as Chinese chipmaker CXMT undercuts DDR4 prices by ~50%. Competition intensifying on mature node memory between established giants and subsidized Chinese challengers.

stories.label: North Korea Workers' Party Congress — Kim outlines new five-year goals
stories.summary: Kim Jong Un used the Workers' Party Ninth Congress to outline new five-year economic and military goals, claiming an 'upsurge' in national development. Most important North Korean political event — sets regime trajectory.

stories.label: Gel material helps mini spinal cords heal from injury
stories.summary: Researchers developed a gel that helps spinal cord organoids recover from injury. Breakthrough in one of medicine's most intractable problems — could lead to treatments for millions with paralysis.

stories.label: 70B-parameter LLM runs on single consumer GPU via NVMe bypass
stories.summary: Open-source project demonstrates running Llama 3.1 70B on a single RTX 3090 by routing data directly from NVMe to GPU, bypassing CPU/RAM bottleneck. Democratizes access to powerful AI models on consumer hardware.

stories.label: Australian warship transits Taiwan Strait tracked by Chinese navy
stories.summary: Australian warship sailed through Taiwan Strait with PLA Navy tracking. Freedom-of-navigation signal ahead of Trump's March 31 Beijing summit. British nuclear sub also arrived in Perth. AUKUS presence strengthening.

stories.label: Sudan war — Museveni hosts RSF leader Dagalo for dialogue
stories.summary: Uganda's Museveni hosting RSF leader Dagalo for dialogue. UN crossed genocide threshold. Controversial legitimization of RSF leadership. Not selected this cycle.

stories.label: Pakistan NW security crisis — military strikes 7 camps after Bannu attack
stories.summary: Pakistan struck 7 TTP and IS-affiliated camps along Afghan border after Bannu suicide attack. Not selected this cycle — no major new development.

stories.label: IS declares new campaign against Syria's post-Assad government
stories.summary: IS released first spokesperson audio in 2 years, declaring priority is overthrowing Sharaa's government. Claimed attacks in Raqqa and Deir al-Zor. Not selected this cycle — covered last cycle, no major new development yet.

stories.label: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire collapse — Hezbollah declares resistance only option
stories.summary: Israeli strikes continue in Lebanon. Hezbollah says 'resistance' is only option. Ceasefire effectively dead. Linked to Iran crisis — Israel may be preemptively degrading Hezbollah ahead of possible Iran strike.

stories.label: Five European nations pledge drone defense production using Ukrainian expertise
stories.summary: E5 nations pledge to leverage Ukraine's battlefield drone expertise for low-cost air defense production.

stories.label: Ethiopia-Tigray-Eritrea: Troop movements raise renewed conflict fears
stories.summary: Military troop movements near Eritrea-Tigray border. 2022 Pretoria peace agreement may be unraveling.

stories.label: Trump to visit China March 31-April 2 for summit with Xi
stories.summary: Trump to visit China March 31-April 2. Now colored by tariff escalation to 15% and Australian warship transit.

stories.label: Chinese chipmaker CXMT undercuts global DDR4 prices by half
stories.summary: CXMT offering DDR4 at ~50% below Samsung/SK Hynix/Micron. Now paired with Samsung reclaiming DRAM market lead — competition intensifying.

stories.label: NASA Artemis II delayed past March over SLS rocket issue
stories.summary: Artemis II pushed from March to at least April. Further delays expected.

stories.label: Philippine senator demands SCS pushback from disputed Thitu Island
stories.summary: Philippine senator visited Thitu Island to call for deepening defense partnerships against Chinese encroachment.

stories.label: Wikipedia bans Archive.today over DDoS attacks and altered captures
stories.summary: Wikipedia deprecated Archive.today over DDoS attacks and altered captures.

stories.label: China's tech giants recruit AI and semiconductor talent in the US
stories.summary: Chinese tech companies aggressively recruiting AI and semiconductor talent in the US.

stories.label: EU excludes China from critical tech research programmes
stories.summary: EU excluded Chinese researchers from AI, semiconductor, and critical tech programmes.

stories.label: Wall Street exodus — investors shifting billions from US to overseas markets
stories.summary: US investors moving billions into emerging markets, Europe, Japan. Direct consequence of tariff chaos.

stories.label: Ancient Australian salt caverns explored as massive energy storage
stories.summary: Queensland salt caverns explored for compressed-air energy storage at grid scale.

stories.label: Germany's CDU/CSU seeks social media ban for under-14s
stories.summary: Germany's ruling CDU/CSU passed motion for social media ban for under-14s with digital age verification.

stories.label: Deepest-ever rock core extracted from under Antarctic ice sheet
stories.summary: Deepest rock core ever drilled through Antarctic ice. Data on ice sheet stability.

stories.label: Venezuela amnesty process expanding — 1,500+ requests received
stories.summary: Venezuela granted amnesty to 379 political prisoners. 1,500+ requests under fast-track protocol.

stories.label: Nigeria Lassa fever outbreak — 22% fatality rate
stories.summary: Lassa fever outbreak in Nigeria at 22% CFR.

stories.label: Thailand election may be voided over barcode blunder
stories.summary: Annulment threat over barcode printing error in ballots.
